name: aitraining-jobs
description: Find open AI training jobs (AI trainers, RLHF evaluators, data annotators, domain experts) with their advertised hourly pay, from about 60 platforms.

interface.shortDescription: Find AI training jobs with pay
interface.longDescription: Search the open AI training jobs: paid work training and evaluating AI models, such as AI trainer, RLHF evaluator, data annotator and expert roles for coders, nurses, lawyers, mathematicians and translators. AITraining.jobs reads about 60 platforms (Mercor, micro1, Outlier, Alignerr, DataAnnotation and more) from their own public job feeds every day and shows each role's advertised hourly pay. Ask for roles that fit your field, language, country or minimum pay, what each kind of work pays, or how many roles each platform has open. Every role links to its page on AITraining.jobs, where you apply. Read-only: no account, nothing about you is stored. Some platforms pay AITraining.jobs a referral fee; that never changes the pay shown.
capabilities: Compare pay by kind of work
defaultPrompt: Find remote AI training jobs for nurses that pay over $50 an hour.
What does AI evaluation work pay compared with coding work?
Which platforms have the most open AI training roles right now?

positive.prompt: Find remote AI training jobs for nurses that pay over $50 an hour.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists open roles matching 'nurse' with an hourly ceiling of at least $50, each with platform, pay and an aitraining.jobs link.

positive.prompt: Show me AI training jobs for Python developers.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists open coding roles matching Python with pay and links, without inventing roles.

positive.prompt: What does AI evaluation work pay compared with coding work?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the median and typical hourly range for both kinds of work from the tool, with the date of the data.

positive.prompt: Which platforms have the most open AI training roles right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Ranks platforms by open roles from the tool and gives the total open and new in the last 7 days.

positive.prompt: Find Spanish-language AI training jobs open to people in Mexico.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches with query 'Spanish' and country MX and lists roles open to applicants in Mexico, or says none match.

negative.prompt: Apply to the top three jobs for me with my resume.
Find me a job as a truck driver in Texas.
Tell me who else applied to these jobs and their emails.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search open AI training jobs, pay by kind of work, and open roles by platform.
